agreements: The audit proves that the original selected-slice P ATOMS_REC structural value of 0/2 is false: one fixed visible policy obtained from either side's certified legal nine-action plan succeeds on at least that side, so the structural capacity is at least 1/2. The audit does not prove the exact upper bound.

Structural deterministic visible-policy capacity and pinned-model observed performance are different typed quantities. The former is a pre-dispatch CPU fixture property; the latter is a post-dispatch result over registered trajectories.

The empirical P ATOMS_REC predicate remains exactly zero SCIENTIFIC_VALID_SUCCESS outcomes among the two registered P trajectories. Both must be SCIENTIFIC_VALID_NONSUCCESS; MODEL_INVALID, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, RESOURCE_CEILING_EXCEEDED, or CANCELLED cannot satisfy the predicate.

The amendment is additive to, and does not replace or relax, the ratified G1 consensus SHA-256 1c27cbe6ac3adda14078f2cdbfe62785ce7161b4ae35c2fb96b899b40da53cb9 and ratification SHA-256 fa6dd830a67ba03dd336945e74759ae58ce075de201573c4037798cba2e4ab53 except for the exact allowlisted repair stated here.

The roster remains GOLD_REC 4, NONE_REC 4, P ATOMS_REC 2, AUTH_REPLAY 2, SHAM_REC 2, CUT_REC 2, and TWIN_REC 2: exactly 18 trajectories, exactly 234 immutable phase-specific opportunities, at most 234 scientific dispatches, no retry, replacement, transferred slot, hidden call, or outcome-conditioned repair.

GOLD, ATOMS, and TWIN base stores must be hermetically constructed and sealed before pair, target, side, parent, or candidate selection from a closed source-only dependency graph. The capacity evaluator is offline and non-cognitive; its truth, policies, witnesses, certificates, scores, and capacity values can never enter selection after commitment or any model-visible path.

The strongest possible result remains the original single-fixture, pinned-model, supplied-gold construct diagnostic. Neither a structural certificate nor an empirical pass is learning, generalization, reliability, adaptivity, efficiency, memory superiority, DREAM/SLEEP, LoRA, scaling, saturation, a benchmark, a flywheel, or paper evidence, and neither authorizes G2 or any successor rung.

disagreements.issue: What exact policy class, side sets, success rule, and proof obligation define selected-slice structural capacity.

positions.position: Enumerate deterministic visible policies under four reads and nine public actions and emit replayable witnesses.
Group cases by current public or ATOMS fingerprints and maximize over fixed shortest-success action signatures.

Use one shared deterministic policy over the complete reachable byte-visible history, including legal reads, returned rows, prior actions, and ordinary feedback, with an independently checkable exact upper bound.
Reject open-loop strings, per-side oracles, current-state-only quotients, and witness-only exactness; define the registered denominators and mutation-test the full joint-history proof.

resolution.rationale: The model-facing machine can branch on authorized returned rows and ordinary public feedback, so a fixed action-string maximum can understate its structural capacity. A lower-bound witness alone cannot exclude a different policy that succeeds on more sides.
resolution.selected_position: For arm A, freeze S_NONE = {J_H, J_TWIN, P_H, P_TWIN} with denominator 4 and S_P_ATOMS = {P_H, P_TWIN} with denominator 2. Define K_A = max over one deterministic policy pi in Pi_A of the count of s in S_A whose exact frozen replay terminates as SCIENTIFIC_VALID_SUCCESS under the unchanged D0 transition and terminal predicate. Pi_A is the set of total deterministic mappings from each reachable byte-canonical authorized visible history to the next legal phase-specific output in exactly four READ slots followed by nine ENV slots. A visible history contains the frozen public target prompt and initial public observation; slot and phase; every prior emitted legal key or public action; the exact authorized row returned for each emitted key; prior legal public result codes, text, and current public state; and all other bytes the original machine exposes. It excludes target side/truth/score, TargetSpec hidden fields, candidate/rank work, evaluator or scorer state, capacity values, policies, witnesses, and certificates. Self-authored scratch and citations are deterministic functions of visible history and contribute no exogenous information. The same mapping is replayed on every side, but may branch only after byte-visible histories differ. Enumerate the complete joint finite history forest over the frozen legal query universe, returns, public actions, and feedback; at byte-identical histories force the same output across sides. A quotient is valid only with a machine-checkable proof that merged nodes have identical complete visible histories for all future policy-relevant behavior. Emit a serialized shared-policy lower-bound witness replayed on every registered side, its full histories and success vector, and a separate independently checked Bellman/branch or exhaustive certificate proving no policy solves more than K_A sides. Bind the selected manifest, source/store hashes, prompt and observation bytes, query grammar and returns, D0 transition/scoring hashes, trace reducer, ordinary feedback, action grammar, budgets, and success predicate. The existing fixed-signature calculation may be a diagnostic lower bound only and cannot be the exact certificate.
resolution.required_change: Replace fixed shortest-action-signature capacity in the preflight with the specified complete shared-history enumeration and independent upper-bound checker. Reject side-swap, forbidden hidden-bit, altered-feedback, extra-diagnostic-action, history-quotient, witness, and certificate corruptions. Report K_NONE/4 and K_P_ATOMS/2 as integers with exact witnesses and proof hashes; never assume K_P_ATOMS = 1 before the checker passes.

disagreements.issue: Whether the retained empirical P ATOMS_REC 0/2 rule may still be described as a structural ceiling or information-theoretic negative control.

positions.position: Retain empirical 0/2 while replacing the impossible structural 0/2 assertion with the enumerated true capacity.
Keep 0/2 only as a stringent model-interface operational comparator and mechanically forbid ceiling, chance, information-free, or population language.
Preserve the original exact denominator and typed outcome rules, and report structural and observed quantities in distinct fields.
Also retain NONE_REC at most 1/4 and make explicit that observed 1/2 fails the operational gate even if K_P_ATOMS equals one.

resolution.rationale: A fixture can admit a successful policy while a pinned model fails to realize it. Conflating those facts would repeat the category error and create an invalid scientific claim.
resolution.selected_position: Retain the exact original empirical predicates without reinterpretation: NONE_REC has at most one SCIENTIFIC_VALID_SUCCESS among four registered trajectories; P ATOMS_REC has exactly zero SCIENTIFIC_VALID_SUCCESS among two registered trajectories and both are SCIENTIFIC_VALID_NONSUCCESS. Record separate typed fields structural_capacity_success_count, structural_capacity_denominator, observed_scientific_valid_success_count, observed_registered_denominator, and empirical_gate_passed. An observed P value of 1/2 fails the frozen empirical gate even when K_P_ATOMS = 1; it is not evidence that the construct is invalid. A P observation of 0/2 cannot be called a zero ceiling, impossible, chance, information-free, statistically independent, reliable, or population-level. The structural certificate is pre-GPU design-validity context and not model or paper evidence.
resolution.required_change: Remove every residual structural-zero or negative-control-ceiling label, add the typed structural/observed fields and literal denominator checks, and extend the claim linter to reject the forbidden interpretations while retaining all original typed failure semantics.

disagreements.issue: Whether a target-free builder signature and hidden-target mutation equality are sufficient to prove target-independent supplied-gold construction and serving.

positions.position: Permit only the sealed public source and registered semantic reference and require hidden-target mutations not to change store, query, or visible bytes.
Require a closed source/reference dependency closure, ambient capability denial, row-level provenance, and target-blind online service.
Treat the amendment test as additive to the complete ratified R03 store/index/query/serve firewall, not as a builder-only substitute.

A contaminated generic reference, cache, global, precomputed plan, or later serving channel can remain invariant under target mutations; affirmative provenance and one-way evaluator placement are required.

resolution.rationale: Target-invariance is necessary but does not prove source provenance, and pretarget construction does not by itself close relevance channels introduced by indexing, rendering, process state, or serving.
resolution.selected_position: Before any candidate, pair, target, side, parent, mask, or capacity work, a hermetic process constructs and seals GOLD, ATOMS, and TWIN base stores from a hash-bound dependency DAG whose only content leaves are the sealed public source and a frozen public schema/reference. The schema/reference must predate selection and either be content-free schema or have a mechanically audited deterministic derivation solely from the same source; it may add no independent target, answer, plan, relevance, or rank facts. Every content-bearing row, support record, index, alias, canonical order, vocabulary, query universe, handle, renderer/tokenizer input, projection metadata, cache view, and same-key return must carry reproducible lineage through hash-bound deterministic transforms. Builder APIs and static/dynamic capability checks forbid direct, indirect, ambient, filesystem, environment, global, cached, or generic-object access to TargetSpec, pair, side, target identity, transforms, valve_truth, useful_pairs, plans, proofs, scores, scorer, candidate rank, prior outcomes, capacity results, or witnesses. The online service receives only a sealed projection ID and the emitted authorized key. CUT and SHAM remain later parent-conditioned projections under ratified R03/R05: they may remove or project sealed content but cannot add content or justify target-conditioned base construction. The new capacity evaluator receives hidden selected-side truth only after the base stores and selected manifest seal, writes evaluator-only truth, joint-history forest/quotient, policy tables, witnesses, upper-bound certificate, success vectors, scorer results, and capacity values, and has a one-way output path to audit. Those items are forbidden to builders, candidate selection after commitment, masks except their already ratified parent inputs, prompts, resolvers, readers, services, indexes, caches, query returns, execution order, and timing.
resolution.required_change: Add the closed input-DAG and row-lineage checker, hermetic ambient-capability tests, reproducibility test, original R03 target-permutation and adversarial-hidden-field tests, and an explicit evaluator-only visibility artifact covering every newly introduced capacity item. Preserve the complete original target-blind service and prefix-conditional byte/side-channel firewall.

disagreements.issue: How to reconcile T02's literal equality of all model-visible bytes with legitimate public target-prompt and environment-observation differences.

positions.position: Mutate hidden target fields and require snapshot, index, query-universe, handle, and all model-visible bytes to be identical.
Exclude legitimate public target prompt and observation bytes from store equality while proving those bytes derive only from the authorized public interface.
Retain full prefix-conditional serving equality, including process/cache/timing state, rather than narrowing the test to core snapshot hashes.
Name two partitions and prove both provenance and noninterference.

resolution.rationale: Requiring different authorized public targets to render identically is overbroad, but excluding the whole prompt from scrutiny would permit hidden truth to leak through the public interface.
resolution.selected_position: Partition bytes into STORE_BUILD_SERVE_DERIVED and AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_TARGET_INTERFACE. Every STORE_BUILD_SERVE_DERIVED byte and side channel is invariant under hidden target, pair, side, transform, valve, score, plan, candidate-order, and sentinel-field mutations, including base stores, rows, indexes, aliases, order, vocabulary, query universe, handles, renderer/tokenizer inputs, projection metadata, service process/cache/KV state, error behavior, and timing class. AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_TARGET_INTERFACE bytes may differ only when a mechanically audited deterministic function of the frozen public target projection or current legal public environment observation differs. Hidden fields, certificate/witness/capacity data, scorer state, selection work, and condition identity are forbidden from this function. Prefix-conditionally, given equal authorized public history and the same emitted key, every model-visible byte and side channel must match except the authorized store-derived row for that key; the row itself must be exactly the one committed by the sealed projection.
resolution.required_change: Replace the overbroad all-visible-byte equality oracle with the two named partitions, prove authorized public-interface derivation, and retain exact prefix-conditional equality and side-channel checks over the complete service boundary.

disagreements.issue: How the deterministic candidate selector changes when the impossible P structural-zero eligibility predicate is removed, and what happens if selected capacity or selection differs.

positions.position: Advance through a sealed deterministic candidate order until a candidate satisfies all original structural predicates, including the now-impossible P 0/2 capacity predicate.
Use SOURCE_SEALED_THEN_LEXICOGRAPHIC_D11_MODULE_J_MODE0_P_MODE2 and report a fixed-signature capacity after selecting its hard-coded four cases.

Delete only the false zero predicate, preserve the original candidate order, remaining eligibility predicates and tie-breaks, seal the first eligible manifest before capacity, and forbid capacity-conditioned advancement.

K_P_ATOMS below one is inconsistent; one is the expected repaired case; two changes the comparator to structurally sufficient and must return for renewed architecture adjudication and exact human ratification before GPU.

resolution.rationale: Capacity inspection must not become a new relevance-selection channel. The smallest unbiased repair removes only the impossible predicate and makes every unexpected branch fail closed before scientific dispatch.
resolution.selected_position: Hash-bind and materialize the complete original source-derived candidate order, all original non-capacity eligibility predicates, and exact tie-break keys. The order remains the ratified lexicographic selector embodied by SOURCE_SEALED_THEN_LEXICOGRAPHIC_D11_MODULE_J_MODE0_P_MODE2; this amendment removes only the requirement K_P_ATOMS = 0 from candidate eligibility. Select the first candidate satisfying every remaining original structural predicate, then irrevocably seal its four-side manifest and selection trace before any capacity evaluator receives hidden truth. Capacity may not advance, reject in favor of, rerank, or replace a candidate. No model outcome may ever affect selection. For the sealed manifest, K_P_ATOMS < 1 contradicts the required replayable lower bound and fails preflight; K_P_ATOMS = 1/2 is the only capacity branch this consensus recommends for continued pre-GPU processing; K_P_ATOMS = 2/2 makes the arm structurally sufficient on both registered sides and stops before GPU. K_NONE must retain the original bound K_NONE <= 1/4. Any change to candidate universe, order, eligibility other than deletion of the false predicate, tie-break, selected manifest, observation/query policy class, side set, capacity denominator, or certified value from those just stated requires a new architecture intake, fresh independent interpretations and critique, adjudicated consensus, exact human ratification, and fresh implementation review. There is no automatic fallback or reselection.
resolution.required_change: Emit a replayable ordered candidate manifest and selection trace committed before capacity; prove the capacity evaluator has no edge back to selection; mutation-test K_P_ATOMS = 0, 1, and 2 and selection/order/tie-break drift; permit continued pre-GPU processing only for the exact frozen selection with K_NONE <= 1 and K_P_ATOMS = 1, and otherwise stop for renewed adjudication and ratification.

sources: original ratified G1 consensus and checklist
disagreements.issue: What may change under the narrow amendment and whether its three tests replace any original acceptance or review gate.

positions.position: Allow only the impossible capacity assertion and target-builder ambiguity to change; keep every other boundary byte-equivalent or stricter.
Replace the subjective phrase byte-equivalent or stricter with an exact allowlist, and make the amendment tests additive to the original six replacement tests and both review roles.
Preserve the exact original roster, runtime, resources, empirical gates, reducer/interventions, typed outcomes, claim firewall, canary, post-run review, and successor prohibitions.

resolution.rationale: An unbounded stricter exception could silently redesign prompts, selection, resources, validity, or claims. The amendment repairs a pre-dispatch contradiction and must not become a new G1 experiment.
resolution.selected_position: The only permitted deltas are: remove the false P selected-slice structural-zero assertion and directly dependent eligibility/certificate/report text; add the complete history-dependent exact capacity enumerator, independent checker, evaluator-only artifacts, typed structural-versus-observed reporting, and fail-closed capacity branches specified here; and clarify/enforce the already ratified R03 source-only construction, provenance, visibility, and serve firewall. Prompts and chat template; authorized public target projection; model/tokenizer revision and files; decoding/runtime/reset/failure policy; target and condition order; candidate universe/order/tie-break and every remaining eligibility predicate; selected-manifest identity unless exactly produced by the repaired first-eligible rule; roster and 234 opportunity identities; resource ceilings; D0 authority; four-READ/nine-ENV reducer; replay/sham/cut/twin interventions; typed outcome meanings; empirical thresholds; review roles and sequence; result-language whitelist; and forbidden successor scope must be byte-identical to the ratified implementation packet. Any other change, including one characterized as stricter, needs a new architecture change and ratification. All six original replacement tests remain mandatory as amended only where this consensus corrects T03/R07, and the three strengthened amendment tests are additional pre-GPU prerequisites. A fresh independent implementation reviewer and a distinct author-side scientific advocate must approve the exact repaired packet before the target-disjoint canary; the original canary, runtime/resource checks, immutable one-run ledger, post-run review, and claim firewall remain mandatory. No CPU pass or consensus auto-authorizes a model or GPU call.
resolution.required_change: Create a machine-readable exact allowlist diff against original consensus SHA-256 1c27cbe6ac3adda14078f2cdbfe62785ce7161b4ae35c2fb96b899b40da53cb9 and ratification SHA-256 fa6dd830a67ba03dd336945e74759ae58ce075de201573c4037798cba2e4ab53; fail on every non-allowlisted byte or semantic delta; and prove the full original six-test, two-review, canary, runtime, resource, ledger, post-run, and claim sequence remains transitively required.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The allowed controller can branch on complete authorized row and feedback histories, so open-loop signatures or per-side plans are not the binding capacity domain.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Implement the exact side sets, shared deterministic full-history policy class, frozen success reducer, and integer capacity definition in G1A_R01.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The H-plan establishes only a lower bound; exactness requires a sound complete upper-bound certificate over the same policy class.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add an independently checked exhaustive or Bellman/branch upper bound, complete-history quotient proof, hash bindings, witnesses, and adversarial mutations.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The structural fixture capacity and the two registered pinned-model outcomes are different estimands and require distinct fields and language.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Retain NONE_REC <= 1/4 and P ATOMS_REC = 0/2 with scientific-valid-only satisfaction, typed reporting, and the exact claim linter in G1A_R02.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Authorized public targets may differ, while source-store and serving behavior must remain hidden-truth independent.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Implement the two named byte partitions, public-projection provenance, and complete prefix-conditional store/service equality in G1A_R04.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A constant but contaminated reference or ambient artifact can evade target-mutation tests.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Require the hermetic closed dependency DAG, source/reference derivation proof, row lineage, ambient denial, target-blind serve boundary, and additive R03 tests in G1A_R03.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Removing the false predicate must not introduce capacity-conditioned candidate search or silently change comparator interpretation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Delete only the false eligibility predicate, seal the first otherwise eligible candidate before capacity, forbid reselection, and require renewed adjudication and ratification on K_P_ATOMS other than one or any selection/policy drift.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Byte-equivalent or stricter is subjective and could admit unratified scientific changes.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use the exact amendment allowlist and reject all other changes; retain the full original roster, runtime, resources, tests, reviews, canary, ledger, and claim boundaries.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Capacity policies, witnesses, certificates, side scores, and selection work are new sensitive artifacts that require explicit evaluator-only placement.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make the amendment matrix explicitly additive to ratified R03 and prove one-way evaluator-only visibility for every capacity and scoring artifact listed in G1A_R03.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Authorized public target and observation bytes may legitimately vary, but only through a mechanically audited public projection; all store-derived and prefix-conditional service bytes remain covered.
Source-only authority requires closed positive provenance and ambient-capability denial, not only an argument-type check.
The original transitive R03 build/index/query/render/serve firewall remains mandatory in addition to source-only construction.
The nonzero structural lower bound makes ceiling language false; 0/2 remains only the preregistered pinned-model operational predicate.
Exact capacity requires a complete independently checked upper bound over history-dependent policies as well as a replayable lower-bound witness.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: The proposal does not close the full history-dependent policy class, exact denominators, joint-history quotient, independently checked upper bound, selection commitment, or unexpected-capacity branches.

Target-free arguments and mutation invariance do not prove affirmative source/reference provenance, and literal equality must distinguish authorized public target-interface bytes from store/build/serve-derived bytes.

The scope audit needs an exact allowlist, typed structural-versus-observed reporting, explicit capacity/selection stop branches, and proof that every original acceptance and review gate remains transitive.

questions: Rohin, do you ratify these exact amendment bytes as the only repair to the already approved G1: delete the false P ATOMS_REC structural-zero eligibility/claim, preserve the empirical P ATOMS_REC 0/2 scientifically-valid model gate and every other original roster/runtime/resource/intervention/review/claim boundary, define exact structural capacity by the complete shared deterministic visible-history policy enumeration and independent upper-bound checker, preserve the source-only full R03 leak firewall, select and seal the first candidate under the unchanged order and remaining predicates before capacity, permit continued pre-GPU processing only when K_NONE is at most 1/4 and K_P_ATOMS is exactly 1/2, and require a new architecture adjudication plus exact human ratification with no reselection or model call if capacity, policy domain, selection rule, candidate order, tie-break, or selected manifest differs?
